description: This file provides a wrapper around the fetch API to simplify HTTP requests, including JSON handling, authorization headers, and query string management. It also exports a factory function to create API clients bound to a token getter.

methods.name: apiFetch(path, { method = 'GET', token, headers = {}, body, query } = {})
methods.description: Performs a fetch request with default headers, optional token, and error handling, returning parsed JSON or text based on response content type.

methods.name: createApiWithToken(getToken)
methods.description: Creates an API helper object with methods (get, post, put, patch, del) that automatically include a token obtained from getToken function.

ctags.name: apiFetch
ctags.pattern: /^export async function apiFetch(path, { method = 'GET', token, headers = {}, body, query } = {}) /
